svg.title: atis: a weather map for a change
svg.desc: atis reads three sources: git for the change and its history, the .check/ folder checkride writes for tests, coverage, and checks, and fallow for health, cycles, and boundaries. It draws the repository as a dark planet of module tiles with the changed area lit in gold. A flight category block reads VFR, glance-mergeable, read in ten seconds, beside the other categories: MVFR, mergeable with a look; IFR, needs instrument review; LIFR, do not approach; and NOINST, no check results to read. checkride gates; atis informs and never blocks. On the line, atis is the last hop: a gated change becomes a weather map.
